== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 2 slip 156), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text (2012 PC website card list). No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-156-Through_The_Force_Things_You_Will_See.png]]) shows the original text of [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V)]] and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-throughtheforcethingsyouwillsee-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E2 text of [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] and, unchanged, [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive). The card list does not show the card type; the image keeps the release sheet's Out Of Play Interrupt and has no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If you are about to recirculate at the end of your turn, and you have fewer cards in Used Pile than in Force Pile, place your Used Pile under your Force Pile instead. OR Place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Force Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore and icons) with the PC-E1 game text, slip number 156 and type Out Of Play Interrupt. Like the printed card (see the PC card image), the title, destiny, lore, card type, game text, caption and copyright are printed upside down; CardMaker draws them upright, so they were turned 180° in place afterwards (art, frame and slip number unchanged). Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
